faq.question: What is MCP?
faq.answer: Model Context Protocol, an open standard for giving AI models secure, structured access to your tools and data. The model calls your systems through a defined, permissioned interface instead of someone copying data in and out.

faq.question: Where is it hosted?
faq.answer: On your infrastructure: AWS, DigitalOcean, your existing cloud or on-premise. You own and control it.

faq.question: How do you keep our data private?
faq.answer: Local PII redaction with tools like Microsoft Presidio, self-hosting, and keeping sensitive data out of third-party model calls entirely where required.

faq.question: Which languages and models do you use?
faq.answer: Python, TypeScript and Java, chosen to fit your stack and your team. Models include Claude, GPT and open-weight models, agreed with your IT team.

faq.question: Can it run on our own infrastructure?
faq.answer: Yes. We deploy in your cloud or on-premise when required, including self-hosted models where data cannot leave your network.

faq.question: Who owns the code?
faq.answer: You do. Code, prompts, eval sets, documentation and data stay with you, in your repositories.

faq.question: How do you know the AI is giving good answers?
faq.answer: We build evals with your team from real examples, run them on every change and trace live calls in Langfuse. Low-confidence outputs go to a person.
